```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r}
correlation <- read.csv("early_pathway_activity_long.csv")
pathways <- read.csv("early_pathway_filtered.csv")
```

```{r}
top_pathways <- pathways %>%
  group_by(database) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(spearman_r)), p_exact) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

top_pathways <- filter(top_pathways, spearman_r > 0.75 | spearman_r < -0.75)
```

```{r}
correlation_filtered <- filter(correlation, pathway %in% top_pathways$pathway)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(top_pathways, aes(x= spearman_r, y = reorder(pathway, spearman_r), fill = spearman_r))+geom_col()+theme_bw()+scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu")+theme(axis.text.y =element_text(size=12, color = "black", face="bold"))
p
ggsave(plot=p, filename = "car_only/early_pathways_correlation_list.png", dpi = 300, height = 10, width = 16)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(filter(correlation_filtered, pathway %in% 
    c("GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_INTERLEUKIN_1")), 
    aes(x= activity, y = persistence_score, label = patient))+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4)+
        geom_point()+geom_text_repel(aes(fontface="bold"))+
        facet_wrap(~pathway, scales ="free")+theme_classic()+
        ylab("Persistence score")+xlab("Early pathway activity")+
        theme(axis.title = element_text(size=14, colour = "black", face = "bold"))
p
ggsave(plot=p, filename="car_only/example_pathway_persistence_score_correlation.png", dpi=300,
height=4,width=4)

```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(filter(correlation_filtered, pathway %in%
    c("HALLMARK_NOTCH_SIGNALING",
    "GOBP_POSITIVE_REGULATION_OF_CELL_FATE_COMMITMENT")) %>%
      mutate(pathway = factor(pathway,
                              levels = c("HALLMARK_NOTCH_SIGNALING",
                                         "GOBP_POSITIVE_REGULATION_OF_CELL_FATE_COMMITMENT"))), 
    aes(x= activity, y = persistence_score, label = patient))+
        scale_colour_manual(values=c("darkred", "royalblue"))+
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = T, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4)+
        geom_point(size=3)+geom_text_repel(aes(fontface="bold", size=5))+
        facet_wrap(~pathway, scales ="free",ncol=1)+theme_classic()+
        theme(strip.text = element_text(size=12, colour="black", face = "bold"))
p
ggsave(plot=p,filename="car_only/cell_fate_and_notch_correlation_examples.png", dpi=300,
height=10, width = 7)

```

```{r}
gene_makeup <- read.csv(("early_pathway_member_genes.csv"))
gene_makeup <- filter(gene_makeup, pathway %in% top_pathways$pathway)
```

```{r}
notch <- filter(gene_makeup, pathway %in% "HALLMARK_NOTCH_SIGNALING")
```
